Chapters: %1$d on the original · %2$d on the destination

%1$d chapters with progress or bookmarks could not be matched. Their data will stay on the original source, which must remain in your library.
All cached reading progress and chapter bookmarks can be matched.
Recommended until you have verified the new source. Turning this off removes only the old library bookmark, not its saved chapter records.
Also match unmatched chapters by list position
Only enable this if both chapter lists have the same ordering. Extra chapters, split parts or missing chapters can make positional matching inaccurate.
%1$d matches use list position rather than a unique number or title.
%1$d original downloads stay on the original source. They are not moved to new URLs; download destination chapters separately for offline reading.
Library categories, pinned status and per-novel reader settings are copied. Matched chapter progress, bookmarks and reading history are merged. Unmatched progress is not guessed.
%1$s is now in your library on the chosen source. %2$d read chapters and %3$d bookmarks were matched.
The original remains in your library.
The original is no longer in the library. Its chapter records were not deleted.
If the destination blocks requests, open it in Browse/WebView to sign in or verify Cloudflare, then try again. No original data is changed on failure.
